Package com.irurueta.authserver.bff.api.web.documents

Class DocumentsExceptionHandler

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.bff.api.web.documents.DocumentsExceptionHandler
@RestControllerAdvice(assignableTypes=DocumentsController.class) public class DocumentsExceptionHandler extends Object
Translates the failures of DocumentsController to RFC 9457 problem details, answered as application/problem+json. The detail is a fixed text: the message of the failure, and anything the resource server said, never reach the browser.
